<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/usage_keys"}
#docs
A key belongs to one customer. Needs `customers:manage`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `string` | **yes** | The usage key write's key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_key`. One of `usage_key`. |
| `key` | `string` | The usage key's key. |
| `customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the usage key was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The usage key. |
| `409` | Another customer has this key. Remove it there first. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usage_keys" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "key": "workspace-4821"
  }'
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [201 Created]
{
  "object": "usage_key",
  "key": "seats",
  "customer": "cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "created_at": "2026-03-14T09:30:00Z"
}
```
```json [409 Conflict]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "conflict_error",
    "message": "Another customer has this key."
  }
}
```
:::
